isaacsim.label: Isaac Sim
notes: App launches Isaac sidecar + Isaac Sim when this target is active.
Keep this target as the safe default while ROS2 hardware path is still in dry-run mode.

ros2_real.label: ROS2 Real Robot
notes: App launches or connects to the ROS2 HTTP bridge when this target is active.
Use transport.baseUrl in config/robot-ros2.json to point at the machine that can reach the live DOGZILLA ROS graph.
ROBOT_RUNTIME_TARGET can override defaultTarget at launch without changing this file.
ROBOT_RUNTIME_DRY_RUN can override dryRun for quick bench testing.
Keep sim and real selection here so one app can compare both paths without prompt changes.
